meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. Each round is a cross-section; the two rounds are comparable by design but are never averaged or chained.
meta.coverage: All India and States/UTs × rural/urban; per-capita monthly value of cereals consumed, ₹, with and without imputation.
meta.note: With imputation adds the value of free grain from the public distribution system, which is why rice and wheat values rise most. "Without imputation" is the headline MPCE convention (comparable across the two rounds); "with imputation" adds the imputed value of items received free of cost through social welfare programmes. Only the 2022-23 and 2023-24 HCES rounds exist in the eSankhyiki API — the 2011-12 and earlier NSS CES rounds are not served and are methodologically different; these series must never be spliced with them.
